summary: AngloGold Ashanti plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing Q3 and nine-month 2026 operating statistics, not a special-situation event. Group gold production was 696koz in Q3 2026 versus 768koz a year earlier, with nine-month output of 2,164koz against 2,292koz. Gold sold totalled 697koz for the quarter. Managed operations contributed 605koz and the Kibali equity-accounted joint venture 91koz. The disclosure notes Serra Grande was sold on 1 December 2025, a completed prior disposal. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are present; no deal-risk arbitrage angle applies.
